name: skills
description: AI coding agent skills — fix recurring failure modes across investigate, integration-audit, knowledge-prune, grill-me, apply-harness.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: All skills bundle — investigate, integration-audit, knowledge-prune, grill-me, apply-harness.

plugins.name: investigate
plugins.description: Systematic bug investigation loop — bug card persistence, falsifiable hypotheses, pattern library. Quick mode for one-off diagnosis without records.

plugins.name: integration-audit
plugins.description: Audit whether a feature is actually complete — dead handlers, broken routes, stub functions, hardcoded dummy data.

plugins.name: knowledge-prune
plugins.description: Audit and clean the .bugs/ knowledge base — deduplicate, consolidate patterns, archive stale records.

plugins.name: apply-harness
plugins.description: Apply orchestrator + specialist agent patterns to a new project — auto-generates CLAUDE.md, agents, and skill files.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentlessly interview a plan or design until every branch of the decision tree is resolved.
